summary.text: Praneet Menon is a candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives in the Orleans-Lamoille District in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from both the Republican and Democratic primaries on August 11, 2026. An aerospace engineer, he is an at-large member of the Coventry School District board.

paragraphs.text: Praneet Menon earned a high school diploma from Saint Peter's Prep, a bachelor's degree from Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute in 2007, and a graduate degree from the University of Vermont in 2013.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born in Mumbai, India, and immigrated to the United States at age 16.
He said he built a career in aerospace and defense, including contracting with the U.S. Armed Forces, and also ran a small software development company.
Menon is an at-large member of the Coventry School District board, with a term ending in 2028, according to Ballotpedia.
In the survey he said he has served on a local planning commission and is chair of both the Coventry School Board and the North Country Supervisory Union Board.
He listed fiscal discipline, housing and workforce development, and the cost of property taxes, energy and health care as campaign priorities.
